Symptoms of commonly associated with HMPV, as noted by the CDC, include: cough and runny or stuffy nose, fever, sore throat, wheezing or shortness of breath in severe cases. In some cases, the infection can escalate to bronchitis, pneumonia or asthma exacerbations.
